rules.name: polaris:business_snapshot_valid
rules.query: (up{job=~"order-service|inventory-service|notification-service"} == 1 and on (job, instance) (polaris_observability_snapshot_success == 1) and on (job, instance) (time() - polaris_observability_snapshot_timestamp_seconds >= 0) and on (job, instance) (time() - polaris_observability_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 45)) and on (job, instance) ((((count by (job, instance) (polaris_outbox_events{status=~"PENDING|RETRY|FAILED|PUBLISHED"} >= 0) == 4) and on (job, instance) (polaris_outbox_oldest_age_seconds >= 0)) and on (job, instance) (polaris_pending_orders{job="order-service"} >= 0) and on (job, instance) (polaris_pending_order_oldest_age_seconds{job="order-service"} >= 0)) or (((count by (job, instance) (polaris_outbox_events{status=~"PENDING|RETRY|FAILED|PUBLISHED"} >= 0) == 4) and on (job, instance) (polaris_outbox_oldest_age_seconds >= 0)) and on (job, instance) up{job="inventory-service"}) or ((count by (job, instance) (polaris_notification_inbox_events{job="notification-service",status=~"PROCESSING|PROCESSED|DEAD_LETTERED"} >= 0) == 3)))

rules.name: PolarisServiceScrapeUnavailable
rules.query: (sum by (job) (up{job=~"gateway|order-service|inventory-service|notification-service"}) == 0) or absent(up{job="gateway"}) or absent(up{job="order-service"}) or absent(up{job="inventory-service"}) or absent(up{job="notification-service"})

annotations.description: No reachable configured target for 2 minutes. This measures monitoring reachability; confirm customer impact separately.
No reachable configured target for 2 minutes. This measures monitoring reachability; confirm customer impact separately.

rules.name: PolarisBusinessTelemetryUnavailable
rules.query: count by (job) (up{job=~"order-service|inventory-service|notification-service"} == 1) unless on (job) count by (job) (polaris:business_snapshot_valid) or (count by (job) (polaris_notification_freshness_seconds_count{job="notification-service"} unless on (job, instance, event_type) polaris_notification_freshness_seconds_bucket{job="notification-service",le="3600.0"}))

annotations.description: No complete successful business snapshot younger than 45 seconds with a non-future timestamp, or a notification freshness bucket is missing. Backlog silence is not recovery.

rules.name: PolarisOrderApiSystemErrors
rules.query: (sum by (job) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="order-service",status=~"5..",uri=~"/api/v1/orders.*"}[5m])) / sum by (job) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="order-service",status=~"2..|3..|5..",uri=~"/api/v1/orders.*"}[5m])) > 0.05 and on (job) sum by (job) (increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="order-service",status=~"2..|3..|5..",uri=~"/api/v1/orders.*"}[5m])) >= 20) or (sum by (job) (rate(spring_cloud_gateway_requests_seconds_count{job="gateway",routeId=~"order-create|order-read",status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum by (job) (rate(spring_cloud_gateway_requests_seconds_count{job="gateway",routeId=~"order-create|order-read",status=~"2..|3..|5.."}[5m])) > 0.05 and on (job) sum by (job) (increase(spring_cloud_gateway_requests_seconds_count{job="gateway",routeId=~"order-create|order-read",status=~"2..|3..|5.."}[5m])) >= 20)

annotations.description: More than 5 percent server errors for 5 minutes, with at least 20 eligible requests per 5-minute window. Client 4xx and actuator traffic are excluded; this is a demo threshold, not SLO attainment.
annotations.summary: {{ $labels.job }} order API has sustained system errors

rules.name: PolarisInventoryRpcSystemErrors
rules.query: sum by (job) (rate(grpc_client_processing_duration_seconds_count{job="order-service",method="ReserveStock",service="polaris.inventory.v1.InventoryService",statusCode=~"UNKNOWN|INTERNAL|UNAVAILABLE|DEADLINE_EXCEEDED|DATA_LOSS|RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED"}[5m])) / sum by (job) (rate(grpc_client_processing_duration_seconds_count{job="order-service",method="ReserveStock",service="polaris.inventory.v1.InventoryService",statusCode=~"OK|UNKNOWN|INTERNAL|UNAVAILABLE|DEADLINE_EXCEEDED|DATA_LOSS|RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED"}[5m])) > 0.05 and on (job) sum by (job) (increase(grpc_client_processing_duration_seconds_count{job="order-service",method="ReserveStock",service="polaris.inventory.v1.InventoryService",statusCode=~"OK|UNKNOWN|INTERNAL|UNAVAILABLE|DEADLINE_EXCEEDED|DATA_LOSS|RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED"}[5m])) >= 20

annotations.description: More than 5 percent system failures for 5 minutes, with at least 20 eligible ReserveStock calls per 5-minute window. Expected precondition/input/auth rejections are excluded. Inspect the order client and inventory service.
annotations.summary: Inventory reservation RPC has sustained system errors

rules.name: PolarisPendingOrdersStalled
rules.query: max by (job) ((polaris_pending_order_oldest_age_seconds{job="order-service"}) and on (job, instance) polaris:business_snapshot_valid) > 120 and on (job) max by (job) ((polaris_pending_orders{job="order-service"}) and on (job, instance) polaris:business_snapshot_valid) > 0

annotations.description: Oldest committed pending order exceeds 120 seconds for 2 minutes with a valid snapshot. Preserve the original order and reservation identity.
Oldest committed pending order exceeds 120 seconds for 2 minutes with a valid snapshot. Preserve the original order and reservation identity.

rules.name: PolarisOutboxStalled
rules.query: max by (job) ((polaris_outbox_oldest_age_seconds{job=~"order-service|inventory-service"}) and on (job, instance) polaris:business_snapshot_valid) > 120 and on (job) max by (job) ((polaris_outbox_events{job=~"order-service|inventory-service",status=~"PENDING|RETRY"}) and on (job, instance) polaris:business_snapshot_valid) > 0

annotations.description: Oldest committed pending/retry row exceeds 120 seconds for 2 minutes. Replica views are not summed; acknowledged attempts alone do not prove database publication state.

rules.name: PolarisOutboxFailed
rules.query: max by (job) ((polaris_outbox_events{job=~"order-service|inventory-service",status="FAILED"}) and on (job, instance) polaris:business_snapshot_valid) > 0

annotations.description: At least one retained committed FAILED row for 1 minute. Restoring Kafka does not automatically requeue terminal rows; controlled replay needs an operator decision.

New failed/acknowledged DLQ sends or committed dead-letter observations in the last 5 minutes. These observations are not queue depth or unique failures; failed DLQ sends retain the source record. Delivery is simulated.
annotations.summary: Notification processing or dead-letter delivery needs investigation

rules.name: PolarisNotificationProcessingLate
rules.query: (1 - sum by (job, event_type) (rate(polaris_notification_freshness_seconds_bucket{job="notification-service",le="3600.0"}[5m])) / sum by (job, event_type) (rate(polaris_notification_freshness_seconds_count{job="notification-service"}[5m]) and on (job, instance, event_type) rate(polaris_notification_freshness_seconds_bucket{job="notification-service",le="3600.0"}[5m]))) > 0.05 and on (job, event_type) sum by (job, event_type) (increase(polaris_notification_freshness_seconds_count{job="notification-service"}[5m]) and on (job, instance, event_type) increase(polaris_notification_freshness_seconds_bucket{job="notification-service",le="3600.0"}[5m])) >= 20

annotations.description: More than 5 percent of at least 20 completed samples per 5-minute window took over one hour for 5 minutes. Includes overflow without a capped quantile. Does not detect unseen broker backlog or prove external delivery.
